tr: Yeni bir bilgisayar aldım. SolarDesk lisansımı yeni bilgisayara nasıl taşıyabilirim?
en: I bought a new computer. How can I move my SolarDesk license to it?
expected: The SolarDesk team installs it on the new computer; it shows a new code; the team registers it and turns off the old license. Customer does nothing on the old computer.

tr: SolarDesk'i kurdum ve ekranda bir kod çıktı. Bu kodla ne yapmam gerekiyor?
en: I installed SolarDesk and a code appeared on the screen. What should I do with this code?
expected: The code is sent to the SolarDesk team; the team registers it with an expiry date and the license becomes active. Nothing to type or activate by the customer.

tr: Lisans süresi dolunca projelerim silinir mi?
en: When my license expires, will my projects be deleted?
expected: Not covered by the policy: the assistant must not answer yes or no; it says it will forward the question to the team. No invented contact details.
